messages:
leo: FYI console alerted: spike in `fncall_parse_errors` for tool `customer.lookup_account` on canary C. Several customers reported "extra token" billing in the last hour. link: https://console/reports/6399991234 :alarm_clock:
devops_bot: ALERT threshold breached: fncall_parse_errors 5m=2.8% (canary-C, us-east-1). sample_trace=6399991234

nina: is this the new strict validator config we pushed for fncall-parsers? We turned on strict_json_schema for canary-C yesterday evening.
priyanka: yes. looks like strict_json_schema=ON in that slice. I see many rejects that are simple shape mismatches (object vs object-with-optional-field) and a handful where tool returned an array for a single object.
leo: customers are getting rejected, then our routing policy retries to a fallback model variant which accepts the response. The fallback attempt sometimes shows up in billing as a separate billed invocation. We need to know if the initial rejected attempt also incurred token billing.
marc: current billing attribution workflow: we normally bill the final successful model route. But ingress-level logging retained both raw attempts for debugging; some downstream billing pipelines pick up ingress logs by mistake. Need to stop that leakage.

nina: immediate mitigation: pause strict_json_schema on canary-C and set permissive_json_heuristics=true. I'll flip the flag if folks agree.
priyanka: agree on pause. Meanwhile we should add trace-level metadata: `attempts[] = {index, outcome, billed_tokens}` and emit a `billing_resolved_to_attempt` pointer. Console can then show which attempt got billed.
leo: propose also adding `reject_reason_code` numeric map: 10=missing_required, 11=unexpected_array, 12=nullable_mismatch, 13=extra_keys. That'll make dashboard queries reliable across schema version changes.
marc: also add boolean `coercion_applied` and `coercion_type` (e.g., unwrap_singleton_array, coerce_null_to_empty_obj). Important for auditing.

priyanka: on coercions: prefer safe heuristics only. For example unwrap_singleton_array only if array length==1 and element validates against expected schema. Gate this by tool-level config `allow_unwrap_singleton`.
nina: rollout plan suggestion: 1) turn strict -> permissive on canary-C now (leo), 2) emit attempt-level traces and sample 5% for 3 hours while we collect data (priyanka), 3) add dashboard row showing billed_tokens per attempt vs final_billed (marc).
leo: agree. Also we should change sampling behavior when billing anomalies detected: auto-upsample traces for affected customer ids to 25% for 30 minutes. That way CS can quickly investigate without full log flood.

marc: ops action created: INC-2026-88 add-billing-attribution-fields + attempt-level tokens + coercion flag (assignee: priyanka).
devops_bot: FLAG update: `fncall.strict.canary-C` toggled OFF by nina (6399991305)
leo: nina confirmed toggle. permissive heuristics ON.
priyanka: starting trace-schema patch now. Plan: runtime emits a compact attempts array stringified inside trace blob (to avoid schema changes to indexing). Format: attempts=\"i:outcome:reason_code:billed_tokens:coercion\"; e.g. \"0:rejected:11:24:false,1:accepted:0:312:false\"
marc: good interim format. Later we can add structured ingest. For dashboards, create mapping table from reason_code to label.

nina: console UX: surface the attempted payload and the validator that failed next to the route decision. Right now you have to open raw trace JSON to see it. Also show a small cost delta estimate when fallback happened.

priyanka: another edgecase: async toolhooks. If initial fncall timed out and we route to async fallback, we sometimes record both as billable in ingestion. Need to ensure `billing_resolved_to_attempt` is authoritative and all downstream billing jobs read that.
marc: we'll add a post-processing canonicalization step in billing pipeline that reads trace pointer and ignores other ingress logs for that request id. I'll own that change.

leo: timeline: nina flipped permissive now. priyanka ETA for trace emit patch 3h, dashboard panel ~2h after traces land, marc to update billing pipeline in 1d. Revisit tomorrow at 10am.
priyanka: noted. I'll also add a toggle `coerce_singleton_array` per tool in runtime config and default it OFF for now. We'll enable after reviewing sampled traces.

devops_bot: ACTION created: DOC-457 add runbook section for fncall billing anomalies (owner: marc).
marc: pinging cs with short note and affected customer list.
nina: thanks team. I'll monitor alerts and upsample if we see billing anomalies persist.
leo: ok great. please post findings in the rollout board and tag me. :thumbsup:
